visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a young girl with long dark hair, her face illuminated by a vibrant green light as she looks upward in awe. The scene cuts to a Lego-themed ride where participants sit in black mechanical chairs with pedals, moving against a backdrop of Lego minifigure murals including knights and skeletons. The lighting is dim and atmospheric with green and red spotlights. (2) The scene shifts to an indoor play area with a black-and-white checkered floor. Multiple children are seen running around, including the main girl in a white shirt and denim shorts. Adults are visible in the background, some holding smartphones to film. The walls are bright red and yellow, featuring glass display cases filled with Lego creations. (3) A first-person perspective shot shows a child sitting in a red Lego ride seat, their hands gripping silver handlebars. In front of them are large Lego-embossed buttons and instructional signage. The environment is warm-toned with wooden wall textures. (4) The video transitions to a digital shooting attraction. Two people are seen from behind, aiming black laser gun controllers at a large screen displaying a Lego animation of a castle. Small digital scoreboards are visible at the bottom of the screen. (5) Children are shown gathered at a long black table with lanes, racing custom-built Lego cars. The camera focuses on hands assembling vehicles using various colored bricks and wheels on a red play table nearby. One completed car features a blue-suited minifigure driver. (6) A large-scale Lego model of the Hong Kong skyline is revealed, featuring iconic buildings like the Bank of China Tower and the Ferris wheel. The model is intricately detailed with thousands of bricks. The lighting shifts to a nighttime mode with blue and purple hues. (7) The final sequence shows a toddler play area with oversized soft Duplo bricks and a large blue slide. The girl from the beginning slides down happily and lands on a green padded floor, smiling at the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male narrator speaking in a clear, friendly, and enthusiastic tone. The background music is a bouncy, upbeat acoustic track with a prominent acoustic guitar rhythm and a light shaker at 125 BPM. The vocal clarity is high with no perceptible distortion. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition sound effect occurs, signaling a change in visual context. The narrator continues his description as faint ambient chatter of children and indoor room resonance becomes briefly audible in the background. (3) Another digital transition SFX triggers, followed by the narrator mentioning Lego facilities. A subtle mechanical whirring sound is detectable beneath the primary audio layers, representing the amusement ride machinery. (4) A digital 'pew-pew' sound effect is heard as the shooting game is shown, perfectly synchronized with the action. The BGM remains steady in volume and energy. (5) Multiple rhythmic 'clicking' and 'clacking' sound effects are introduced during the racing car building sequence, simulating the physical sound of Lego bricks being joined. The narrator’s pitch remains energetically high. (6) A final whoosh transition lead into the description of the Lego city models. The audio track concludes with the narrator's enthusiastic summary and the joyful, high-pitched laughter of a child landing on a padded mat, while the BGM fades out.

It aims to showcase the variety of interactive attractions available for families and children, emphasizing the fun and educational aspects of the venue to encourage viewers to visit.
